potential.note: Potential adds PvP-only stats (weapons/accessories: +0.5%/level PvP Damage Boost; armor: PvP Damage Tolerance). Always succeeds, requires Soul Bound gear, costs Potential Stones + 100,000 Abyss Points per level.

tiers.label: ilvl 86 — Fire Temple / Ferocious Horn band

notes: Success rates and pity are community-derived from the live client (metabot.gg); NCSoft publishes no official table.

Per-attempt costs are anchored to documented totals: an ilvl-86 helm +0→+10 ≈ 30,920 stones + 775,100 Kinah; an ilvl-102 piece +0→+10 ≈ 36,680 stones + 920,400 Kinah. ilvl 54/70 values are interpolated estimates.
The published ilvl-102 average for +0→+15 (~15.0M Kinah, ~190,700 stones) implies per-attempt cost escalates in the +10→+15 range — treat flat-model totals as lower bounds.
Failures never destroy regular gear (Kinah + stones only) and each failure at the same step adds ~+5% soft pity, resetting on success. Sole downgrade exception: the Clash Rune.
Extraction refunds Enhance Stones but not Kinah; gear cannot be sold to NPCs.
